title: Average query cost and leaf count
statement: Let a deterministic decision tree query coordinates of an input in the finite sign alphabet $\{\pm 1\}^n$, branching according to each queried sign, and let its number of leaves be $L$. Under the uniform product distribution on inputs, its average number of queries is at most $\log_2 L$.
hypotheses_covered: The tree is a finite decision tree over the sign alphabet
The tree queries coordinates among the $n$ input coordinates
The input distribution is the uniform product distribution
